name: CRB2 holder dividends paid on current balances to any transfer trigger
summary: CRB2 kept holder dividends as USDT in the token and paid them out ten holders at a time during ordinary transfers, pro rata to each holder's balance at that moment, with no snapshot or holding period. Attackers flash-bought CRB2 into many holder contracts, fired hundreds of transfers to collect the accumulated dividends and sold back; the June 2024 transaction also wash-traded so every sell dumped the token's maxHodler stash into the pool, refilling the dividend pool before collecting it.
notes: The DeFiHackLabs transaction 0xde59f5bd (June 2024) is not the first: 0x5f045de5 drained the dividend pool through attack contracts 0x20d5ada2 and 0x13df55bd in six transactions on 2024-05-12. Sampling the token's USDT every 10,000 blocks from deployment shows no earlier drop over 300 USDT; afterwards the pool held about 410 USDT until 0xde59f5bd. 0x22d7c304 is the owner's rescueToken() of the 4,906 USDT left, not an exploit.

Loss: in the May transactions, the token's own USDT outflow (gross, loss.mjs). In 0xde59f5bd the token gained USDT net and the value came from the maxHodler stash (943.2B CRB2) dumped into the pool; CRB2 is unpriced and the dump crashed it, so the stash is valued at the attacker's net USDT gain in that transaction (rule 12).
